review_boundaries: Expected booleans are normative design, not observed predicate results. Do not report RED/GREEN until a separate authorized test run.
Do not resume, regrade, verify-only, replay or alter the original terminal FAIL root. These are new offline seam inputs.
Full artifact and before-state are independent authorities; coordinated prose never resolves live identities or maps display labels to native class IDs.
Policy checkpoint remains separate: authorization prose neither creates nor replaces the durable Gateway authorization receipt. N17 rejects missing primary effect regardless of actual receipt.
Positive P05 deliberately removes optional baseline bookkeeping; no new baseline, timing or business-effect credit follows from auxiliary prose.
Retain existing fail-closed version/artifact/native-descriptor, stage-ordering, extra-owner/edit and all prior negative controls.
No prompt/suite/oracle/runtime changes, LLM grading or lexical phrase whitelist.
